info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts TestCases API
UiPath List Test Cases in a Project

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the test project

items.docs: Retrieves all test cases defined within a specific test project. Each test case represents a single test scenario with preconditions, steps, and expected results. Supports pagination and filtering. Requires the TM.TestCases or TM.TestCases.Read OAuth scope.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the test project

items.docs: Creates a new test case within a test project. The test case can be linked to automation packages deployed in Orchestrator to enable automated test execution via test sets. Requires the TM.TestCases OAuth scope.

info.name: UiPath Get a Test Case by ID

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the test project

params.name: testCaseId
params.description: Unique identifier of the test case

items.docs: Retrieves a specific test case by its unique identifier within a project. Returns full test case details including steps, labels, custom fields, automation linkage, and preconditions.
